<entry id="A03208">
<head-word>אֶרֶס, </head-word>
<head-word>אֶירֶס</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (√רס; v. 
<xref rid="T00859">רְסַס</xref>; as to modification of meaning cmp. Lat. 
<italic>virus</italic>) prop. 
<italic>drop, fluid</italic>.</definition>
<notes> esp. 
<italic>poison</italic>. Y. Ter. III, beg. 42
<sup>a</sup> the serpent הטיל בו א' threw a drop (of poison) into it. Sabb. 62
<sup>b</sup> (play on 
<italic>t’akkasnah</italic>, Is. III, 16) כארס בכעוס (read כא' עכיס; v. Var. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) like the serpent’s poison; a. fr.—Y. Maasr. V, end, 52
<sup>a</sup> an onion שאין לו אירם (read אירס) which has no penetrating moisture.—
<plural-form>Pl. אֵרְסִין, אֵירְסִין</plural-form>. Y. Ter. VIII, 45
<sup>ed</sup>. Cmp. רִיס.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="A03210">
<head-word>אָרַס</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h. </language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="unknown">ארשׂ Pi.; √אר</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> , v. 
<xref rid="A03247">ארר</xref>) 
<italic>to bind, join; to betroth</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Part. pass. אָרוּס, f. אֲרוּסָה 
<italic>betrothed, engaged</italic>. Keth. 13
<sup>b</sup> אָרוּס וַאֲרוּסָתוֹ a betrothed couple. Y. Ḥag. II, 77
<sup>d</sup> אֲרוּסִי my betrothed, i.e. my beloved citizen.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אֵרַס, אֵירַס</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to betroth to one’s self, engage in marriage</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Bets. V, 63
<sup>a</sup> bot. לְאָרֵס. Ib. הא לארס יְאָרֵס but betroth he may; a. fr.—Yeb. VI, 4 אירס וכ' he betrothed a widow. Keth. I, 6 אֵרַסְתַּנִי, אֵרַסְתִּיךְ; a. fr. [As to the legal status of betrothal, v. אֵרוּסִין.]</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to give away in betrothal</italic> (of the bride’s father).</definition>
<notes> Ib. IV, 2.—Part. pass. מְאוֹרָסָה. Snh. VII, 9; a. fr.—Ex. R. s. 33 (play on 
<italic>morashah</italic>, Deut. XXXIII, 4).—</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa. a. Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְאָרְסָה, נִתְאָרְסָה</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be betrothed</italic> (only of the woman).</definition>
<notes> Keth. III, 3; a. e.—Yeb. IV, 10 הנשואות יִתְאָרְסוּ וכ' those who have been married before, may get betrothed (before the expiration of three months after separation from their husbands by death or divorce), and those who have been betrothed (and not yet married), may get married (during the above term).</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="A03211">
<head-word>אֲרַס</head-word>
<head-word>אָרַס</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, fut.</definition>
<notes> יֵירוּס, ch. same. Targ. O. Deut. XXVIII, 30; a. fr.—(אַרְסָא) מְאַרְסָא 
<italic>betrothed woman</italic>. Targ. Y. Lev. XX, 10. Targ. Ex. XXII, 15 (16).—*Cant. R. to IV, 12 אֲרוּסָתֵיה or אֲרוּסְתֵּיה (Chald. suffix) his betrothed.—[Lev. R. s. 34 דאינון מארסוון, read מאנסיכון, v. אֲנַס, or דאתון מיזדמיין, v. זְמֵי.]</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִתְאֲרִיס</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, contr. אִתְרִיס (cmp. אֲנַס Ithpe.) 
<italic>to be betrothed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> בת אִיתְרוּסֵי 
<italic>marriageable</italic>. Gitt. 43
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<italic>cotton</italic>. [The entire sentence, however, seems to be misplaced, and a repetition of a preceding one.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="A03214">
<head-word>אָרְסְקִינָס</head-word>
<pos> pr. n. m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>Ursicinus</italic>, a Roman general delegated against Judea by Gallus who, as Constantine’s nephew and associate emperor, resided at Antiochia.</definition>
<notes> Y. Yeb. XVI, beg. 15
<sup>c</sup>; Y. Sot. IV, 23
<sup>c</sup> bot. א' מלכא U. the king (royal governor?). Y. Shebi. IV, 35
<sup>a</sup> הורון מֵפֵי … לא'; Y. Bets. I, 60
<sup>c</sup> bot. הורי פיתא לא' וכ' (insert מֵפֵי) the sages allowed to have bread baked on the Sabbath for (the army of) U. because his intercession might be needed. [Diff. explan. of latter sentence, v. Frankel 
<italic>M’bo</italic>, p. 56
<sup>a</sup>.] Y. Ber. V, 9
<sup>a</sup>. Y. Meg. III, 74
<sup>a</sup> top א' אוקיד וכ' U. burnt the scrolls of the Law of the congregation of Zennabris.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="A03215">
<head-word>אָרַע</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (√רע, v. 
<xref rid="T00914">רעע</xref>) 
<italic>to strike against.</italic></definition>
<notes>
<italic> Nif.</italic> נֶאֱרַע 
<italic>to come in contact with</italic> (cmp. זווג), 
<italic>to happen, befall</italic> (gen. of evil occurrences). Ber. IV, 2 שלא תֵּאָרַע וכ' (Bab. ed. 28
<sup>b</sup> שלא יֵאָרַע דבר וכ') that no (religious) offence may happen through me (by an erroneous decision &c.). Yoma I, 1 שׁמא יארע בו פסול lest something may occur to him to unfit him for services. Esth. R. to II, 7 שיארע על ישראל (read שיארע לישר') will happen to Israel; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אֵירַע, אִירַע</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to strike, befall;</italic> (neut. v.) 
<italic>to occur</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Kidd. I, 58
<sup>d </sup>top ולא א' מעשה no accident (illegal act) 
<italic>occurred</italic>. Gen. R. s. 84 כל מה שאירע לזה וכ' whatever befell the one, befell also the other; a. fr.—M. Kat. II, 1 אֵירְעוֹ אבל (Ms. M. אירע בו) mourning in the family befell him; a. e.—Y. Shek. V, 48
<sup>d</sup> bot. כך וכך אירע; Y. Dem. I, 22
<sup>a</sup> אירעון … (read אירעוֹ) so and so it happened to him. 
<italic>Part. Pu</italic>. מְאוֹרָע q. v.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְאָרֵעַ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be added to, to join</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Sot. I, 17
<sup>a</sup> אחת מִתְאַרְעָה לאחת וכ' one (sin) is added to the other, until the account is full; Num. R. s. 9.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="A03216">
<head-word>אֲרַע, </head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>(in Targ. Y.; in O. usu. עֲרַע q. v.) same; 
<italic>to join, meet, find; to attack, visit</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. Gen. XIX, 19 תִירְעִינַנִי may befall me Targ. Y. Deut. XXXII, 10 (h. text מצא). Targ. Y. Ex. V, 3 (h. פגע). Ib. IV, 2 (h. פגש; ed. Vien. ועַרַע read וַאֲרַע). Targ. Y. Lev. V, 7 לא תֶאֱרַע ידיה he will not be able, cannot afford (h. text תגיע וכ', cmp. תמצא ידו); a. fr. [Targ. Y. II, Ex. XV, 9 ואַרְעֵי יתהון (I ונָרַע, וגדע) read ואֶירַע and I shall meet them.]</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִתְאָרַע, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִיתְרַע, אִירַע</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> or 
<italic>Pa</italic>.</definition>
<notes> אַרַע 
<italic>to be met; to meet</italic>. Targ. Y. I, Num. XXIII, 15 אֶתְעָרַע (h. text אֶקָּרֶה). M. Kat. 18
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. איתרע ביה מילתא an accident befell him (death in the family).—Lev. R. s. 37 אַרְעַת שעתא it so happened. Koh. R. to XI, 1 ארעת ענת' וכ' it happened to be the season when the Israelites travelled to Jerusalem. Y. Dem. I, 22
<sup>a</sup> אירעון, v. preced. Targ. Esth. VIII, 8 תִתְּרַן = תתארען; Targ. Y. Gen. XLIV, 34 תברז (corr. acc.). [אתרע 
<italic>to be shaken, weakened</italic>, v. רעע.]</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Af.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אוֹרַע</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition/>
<notes> = Pe. Targ. Ruth II, 3; a. e.—Targ. Ps. LXXXV, 11 אוֹרְעוּן (some ed. אָרְעִין Pe.) meet each other.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="A03217">
<head-word>*אָרַע, </head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (√רע, cmp. רוּעַ, 
<italic>Hif.</italic> הֵרִיעַ, cmp. קָרָא a. קָרָה) 
<italic>to proclaim a festival</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sifré Num. 147 אֵירְעוֹ במאכל 
<pgbrk id="pg125"/>וכ' proclaim it (as מקרא קדש) with special meal and dress; v. Mekh. Bo 9, beg.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pu.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אֹורָע</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be proclaimed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Bath. 113
<sup>b</sup> with והיתה … משפט (Num. XXVII, 1</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition/>
<notes> אוֹרְעָה כל וכ' the whole section has been proclaimed as of a judicial nature; (Ms. M. הודעה, v. 
<xref rid="J00106">יָדַע</xref>).</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="A03218">
<head-word>אֲרַע, </head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (Targ. Y., O. usu. עֲרַע q. v.), 
<italic>Pa</italic>.</definition>
<notes> אָרַע, אַרַע same. Targ. Y. Lev. XXIII, 2; a. fr. Targ. O. Num. X, 2 לעָרָעָה ed. Berl. (oth. ed. לאַרְעָא); (Targ. Y. לעָרָעָא, לעַרְעָא!). [Targ. Y. Lev. XXIII, 4 דִּי יִתְרְעוּן, corr. די תְאַרְעוּן. Ib. 21, a gloss חיין וקיימין הי בזמן ref. to the festive benediction שהחייני וקימנו וכ'.]—Denom. מְאַרְעָא, מְעַרְעָא.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="A03220">
<head-word>אִרְעָא</head-word>

<senses>
<sense>

<italic>accident, occurrence</italic>.</definition>

<entry id="A03221">
<head-word>אַרְעָא</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (√רע,
<language-key> h. </language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A03230">אֶרֶץ</xref></language-reference> q. v.) [the brittle] 
<italic>land, earth, ground, field</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Gen. I, 1. Targ. Y. Gen. XVI, 5; a. fr.—B. Bath. 29
<sup>a</sup> חדא א' one field; v. בָּאגָא.—Bekh. 25
<sup>b</sup> א' דחשוכא a land of darkness (Babylon); a. fr.—Sabb. 65
<sup>a</sup> בת א' (a Chaldaic adaptation of ποδάγρα, podagra) 
<italic>gout, sore on the toes</italic>.—עמא דא' = עם הארץ, v. אֶרֶץ.—
<plural-form>Pl. אַרְעָן, אַרְעָאן, אַרְעיָּין</plural-form>. Targ. Jer. XXVIII, 8 Levita, Targ. II Esth. IV, 1. Usu. אַרְעָתָא. Targ. Gen. XXVI, 3; a. fr.—B. Bath. 12
<sup>b</sup>; 61
<sup>b</sup>
<italic>fields</italic>.—B. Kam. 7
<sup>a</sup> הוקר א', הוזל א' (Ms. M. זול, sub. דמי) land fell, rose in price. V. לְאַרַע.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="A03222">
<head-word>אַרְעָאָה, </head-word>
<head-word>אַרְעָיָיה</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (preced.) 
<italic>earth-ward, that which, he who, is below, nethermost</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Josh. XVI, 3; a. fr.—Y. Kil. IX, end, 32
<sup>d</sup> שלח א' to put off the undergarment. Y. B. Mets. X, beg. 12
<sup>c</sup> ארעייא who lives in the story below.—
<plural-form>Pl. אַרְעָאִין, אַרְעָאֵי</plural-form>. Targ. Gen. VI, 16; a. e.—Lam. R. to I, 16 עביד בא' וכ' deal with the inferiors (females) as thou didst with the superiors (men); ib. to IV, 19; Y. Succ. V, 55
<sup>b</sup> (incorr. vers.).—Fem. אַרְעִיתָא. Targ. Ez. XLI, 7; a. fr.—Y. Maas. Sh. V, 56
<sup>c</sup> top.—
<plural-form>Pl. אַרְעַיָּתָא, אַרְעַיָּיתָא</plural-form>. Targ. Ez. XLII, 5; 6. Y. Yoma I, 38
<sup>c</sup>; Y. Meg. V, 75
<sup>c</sup> bot., v. אִסְכּוּפְתָּא. [Targ. Esth. אַרַע מיניה, v. לְאַרַע.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="A03395">
<head-word>אֵת, </head-word>

<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A01639"> cmp. אִית</xref>,

<sense>

<italic>essence</italic>], a particle of the objective case, but also used as a noun, 
<italic>the thing</italic> (
<italic>which</italic>) (cmp. Koh. IV, 3, v. אוֹת III).</definition>
<notes> Ohol. II, 4 את ש … עליו that upon which … Zeb. 72
<sup>b</sup>; Bets. 3
<sup>b</sup> את שדרכו למנות שנינו we read (Orl. III, 7) that which it is customary to count singly, opp. כל שדרכו וכ' whatever is sometimes counted singly; a. fr.—Ber. I, 1 קורין את שמע we read the 
<italic>Sh’ma’</italic>, a. v. fr.—[The fact that את as a particle of the objective case may be dispensed with, and that את (fr. אתת 
<italic>to join</italic>) may have the meaning of 
<italic>with</italic>, gave rise to a method of Biblical interpretation by which, wherever את occurs in the Bible, esp. in laws, an amplification by implication is looked for.] Pes. 22
<sup>b</sup> את לרבות וכ' the word 
<italic>eth</italic> (Deut. X, 20 [with] the Lord thy God thou shalt fear [some one else] intimates that we must pay reverence to the scholars next to God. Ib. ואידך את לא דריש and as to the other authority (that differs)? He does not interpret 
<italic>eth</italic> (as having a particular meaning); a. fr.—

<italic>eth</italic> occurring in Scripture, as a substratum for interpretation. Ib. היה דורש כל א' וכ' used to interpret every 
<italic>eth</italic> in the Law; a. fr. Num. R. s. 10 זו אחת מג' א' וכ' this is one of the three 
<italic>eths</italic> &c.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<italic>surely, indeed</italic>. Y. Ber. II, 5
<sup>c</sup> bot.; a. fr.; (v. יבוא עלי, s. v. בּוֹא).—Y. Shebi. VI, 36

<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. תא חזי; Y. Dem. VI, 25

<sup>a</sup>; a. fr. [אתא נסיא Y. Meg. II, 73
<sup>b</sup>, a. e., read אֲתָאנַסְיָא q. v.] [Targ. Y. II Deut. XXXIII, 16 יַתְיַן, 3rd pers. fem. fut.]</notes></sense></senses>
